title: GUI DDE ACK proxy window validation
contracts: DDE conversation identity is a pair of participating window handles
DDE ACK proxy startup is for direct SendMessageA and SendMessageW requests
SendMessageTimeoutA and SendMessageTimeoutW remain on the normal timeout broker path
SendPostMessageSlave must validate the client HWND with IsWindow before allocating proxy arguments or creating DdeProxyThreadSlave
DdeProxyThreadSlave preserves the existing initial WM_DDE_ACK and posted DDE bridge topology
SREV-084 owns DDE ACK lParam forwarding and SREV-293 owns the guidde topology comment
Windows runtime proof is still required for DDE proxy behavior
local_edges: Gui_SendMessageA/W WM_DDE_ACK -> Gui_DDE_ACK_Sending -> GUI_SEND_POST_MESSAGE which sm a/sm w
Gui_SendMessageTimeoutA/W -> GUI_SEND_POST_MESSAGE which smta/smtw -> normal timeout broker path
GuiServer SendPostMessageSlave WM_DDE_ACK direct SendMessage -> IsWindow client HWND -> DdeProxyThreadSlave
DdeProxyThreadSlave -> initial SendMessage client WM_DDE_ACK -> posted DDE bridge
runtime_gate: Windows SbieSvc and DLL build with direct DDE SendMessage proxy smoke, stale client HWND no-proxy proof, and SendMessageTimeout normal broker proof
